content:
{'蘋果公司與歐盟就iPhone應用程式銷售問題長期持續的反壟斷爭議，看來終於告一段落。': "Apple and the EU's long-running antitrust dispute over iPhone app sales appears to have finally come to an end."}

{'歐盟表示歡迎蘋果在區內推出的新應用程式佣金收費標準。根據修訂後的條款，開發者將按其營業額及所選銷售渠道，繳付介乎5%至26%不等的佣金或費用……': "The EU has welcomed Apple's new app commission fee structure in the region. Under the revised terms, developers will pay commissions or fees ranging from 5% to 26%, depending on their revenue and chosen sales channels..."}

{'歐盟法例要求蘋果允許第三方應用程式商店運作。蘋果雖已遵從，但因向第三方銷售收取的佣金及費用而遭到投訴。': 'EU law requires Apple to allow third-party app stores to operate. While Apple has complied, it faced complaints over the commissions and fees it charges for third-party sales.'}

{'蘋果本週全面引入新條款，而歐盟方面似乎對此感到滿意。': 'Apple has fully introduced the new terms this week, and the EU appears to be satisfied.'}

  • {'透過蘋果應用程式內購功能銷售的應用程式，佣金率為26%。至於絕大多數開發者，包括參與「應用程式小型企業計劃」、「迷你應用程式夥伴計劃」或「影片夥伴計劃」的開發者，以及首年後自動續訂的訂閱服務，佣金率為15%。': "For apps sold through Apple's in-app purchase system, the commission rate is 26%. For the vast majority of developers — including those participating in the App Store Small Business Programme, Mini Apps Partner Programme, or Video Partner Programme, as well as subscription services that auto-renew after the first year — the commission rate is 15%."}
  • {'使用替代付款處理方式的應用程式商店應用程式，佣金率為20%。參與上述計劃的開發者則可享較低的10%費率。': 'For App Store apps that use alternative payment processing, the commission rate is 20%. Developers participating in the aforementioned programmes are eligible for a lower 10% rate.'}
  • {'在應用程式內透過外部連結完成購買的應用程式商店應用程式，佣金率為15%。參與上述計劃的開發者同樣可享較低的10%費率。': 'For App Store apps where purchases are completed via external links within the app, the commission rate is 15%. Developers participating in the aforementioned programmes are likewise eligible for a lower 10% rate.'}
  • {'經由替代應用程式市場或網頁分發的應用程式，蘋果將收取5%的「核心技術佣金」。': 'For apps distributed through alternative app marketplaces or the web, Apple will charge a 5% "Core Technology Fee".'}

{'歐盟委員會接受《愛爾蘭獨立報》採訪時表示，歡迎這些新條款。': 'The European Commission told the Irish Independent that it welcomes the new terms.'}

{'發言人表示：「委員會歡迎蘋果對其商業條款所作出的調整。委員會早於2025年4月就蘋果的引導條款發出不合規決定，並就替代應用程式分發方式提出初步調查結果，雙方隨後展開密切對話，這次的條款修訂正是基於相關對話而達成的。隨着今天公布新安排，委員會將監察蘋果切實落實新條款的情況。」': 'A spokesperson said: "The Commission welcomes the adjustments Apple has made to its commercial terms. The Commission issued a non-compliance decision regarding Apple\'s steering terms back in April 2025 and presented preliminary findings on alternative app distribution, following which both sides engaged in close dialogue that led to these revised terms. With today\'s announcement of new arrangements, the Commission will monitor Apple\'s effective implementation of the new terms."'}

{'9to5Mac觀點': "9to5Mac's take"}

{'這場歷時已久的爭議似乎終於解決。然而，美國的情況卻非如此。最新的發展是，蘋果希望與Epic Games進行和解談判，但這間遊戲開發商認為此舉不會有實質成果。法庭將決定下一步的安排。': 'This long-running dispute appears to have finally been resolved. The situation in the United States, however, is a different story. The latest development is that Apple is seeking settlement talks with Epic Games, but the game developer does not believe this will yield substantive results. The court will determine the next steps.'}
